title: 第21章 小的三代养犬第22章 月黑风高夜
slug: 转世成女开局攻略气运之子
content_zh:
那画像不是别人，正是铁元城佣兵团的团长铁虎。
两人见状，连忙摇头。
那天杀铁虎时，方玉凝可以确信没有放跑任何一个人。
所以对方来此寻找，应当只是巧合。
摇头否认，方玉凝一眼望去，只见不大的市集，不知何时竟然已经站满了身穿皮甲的士兵。
四五十号人，每一个气息都在凝血五六层。
各个腰胯战刀，眼带杀气，看样子像是铁元城的正规兵士。
部队最前头，三五人穿着铁甲，端坐于战马上。
身上气血之力最为浓郁，排头那个跟那天的铁虎还有几分相似。
只是脸上少了道疤痕。
方玉凝眸光闪烁，为首几人的信息面板，出现在她眼前。
【铁彪-铁元城城卫军副统领】
【境界：玄骨境九层】
【气运：绿（960）】
【注解：为弟寻仇而来，正在寻找其弟尸首】
......
【许强-铁元城城卫军百夫长】
【境界：玄骨境七层】
【气运：白（99）】
......

【黄延-铁元城城卫军百夫长】
【境界：玄骨境六层】
【气运：白（98）】
三个玄骨境、十二个通脉境。
盲猜应该还有几十个凝血境三四层的喽啰。
得知信息后，方玉凝面色略显凝重。
就现在的情况来看，不发生冲突最好。
若是发生冲突，恐怕是一场恶战。
三个玄骨境，交由她和两个护卫处理。
但林尘只是凝血境四层，即便有外挂傍身，恐怕也难敌得过十二个通脉境。
见两人摇头，手持画像那人深深的看了两人一眼。
随后又道：“再看仔细些，当真没见过？”
说着，还将那画像推至两人跟前。
“确实不曾见过。”
方玉凝淡定说着，心中却是暗暗吐槽。
这画像美颜的着实过分，把那最有灵魂的疤痕画淡了这么多。
就算是真见过，也未必能第一时间认出来。
闻言，那人长叹一声，转身打算离开。
见状，两人不约而同的，都长舒了口气。
content_en:
That portrait was none other than Tie Hu, the leader of the Tieyuan City mercenary group.
When the two saw this, they quickly shook their heads.
When Tiehu was killed that day, Fang Yuning could be sure that no one was let go.
Therefore, it should be just a coincidence that the other party came here to look for her.
Shaking her head in denial, Fang Yuning looked around and saw that the small market was already filled with soldiers wearing leather armor.
No. 40 or 50 people, every breath is coagulating five or six layers of blood.
With swords on each waist and a murderous look in their eyes, they looked like regular soldiers from Tieyuan City.
At the front of the army, three or five people were wearing iron armor and sitting upright on their horses.
The power of Qi and blood in his body is the strongest, and the one at the front is somewhat similar to the iron tiger from that day.
There's just one scar missing on the face.
Fang Yuning's eyes flickered, and the information panels of the leaders appeared in front of her.
[Tie Biao-Deputy Commander of Tieyuan City Guards]
[Realm: Ninth Level of Mysterious Bone Realm]
[Luck: Green (960)]
[Note: I came here to seek revenge for my brother, and I am looking for his brother’s body]
...
[Xu Qiang - Centurion of Tieyuan City Guards]
[Realm: Seventh Level of Mysterious Bone Realm]
[Luck: White (99)]
...
[Huang Yan - Centurion of Tieyuan City Guards]
[Realm: Sixth Level of Mysterious Bone Realm]
[Luck: White (98)]
Three profound bone realms and twelve meridional realms.
A blind guess would be that there are dozens of minions at the third and fourth levels of the blood coagulation realm.
After learning the information, Fang Yuning looked slightly solemn.
Judging from the current situation, it is best not to have a conflict.
If there is a conflict, it will probably be a fierce battle.
The three Mysterious Bone Realms were left to her and two guards to handle.
But Lin Chen is only at the fourth level of the Blood Coagulation Realm. Even if he has a cheat at his side, he may not be able to defeat the twelve Tongmai Realm.
Seeing the two of them shaking their heads, the man holding the portrait looked at them deeply.
Then he added: "Look more carefully, do you really think you haven't seen it before?"
As he said that, he pushed the portrait in front of the two of them.
"I've definitely never seen it before."
Fang Yuning said calmly, but secretly complained in her heart.
The beauty of this portrait is really too much, and the scars that have the most soul are faded so much.
Even if you actually see it, you may not be able to recognize it immediately.
Hearing this, the man sighed and turned around to leave.
Seeing this, the two of them breathed a sigh of relief.
